text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B after a gain felt satisfying, but I should base sales on future prospects and portfolio risk, not the pleasure of locking in a profit.","Holding Stock A through a steep loss and then selling may reflect loss aversion; I should reassess the investment objectively rather than wait for my cost basis.","A few months of gains and declines are not enough to judge a strategy, so I should diversify and make disciplined decisions instead of reacting to short-term account swings."]}
